title: CAD Validator system design
summary: An independent polling worker that proves hash-bound accepted or candidate CAD source before completing validation or scheduling accepted-source export.

nodes.label: Validation Jobs
nodes.description: Postgres generation_jobs rows for validate_cad work and its durable validation result.

details.responsibility: Own validate_cad lifecycle state, the source identity bound to each job, and the durable schema-v2 result.

inputs.name: validate_cad row
inputs.description: Job type, source kind, source path, source SHA-256, project, part, and optional edit ownership.

outputs.name: claimed job
outputs.description: The oldest queued supported row after its status is changed to running.

outputs.name: validation result
outputs.description: Completed, failed, or cancelled status with result and concise error text.

durableReads: Oldest queued validate_cad row selected with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED.
durableWrites: error_message when validation does not pass
guarantees: Claim selection and the queued-to-running status update occur in one database function.

nodes.label: 1. Job Claim
nodes.description: Polls for and atomically claims the next queued validate_cad generation job.

details.responsibility: Ask Postgres for one queued validate_cad job and hand a returned row to the validation pipeline.
trigger: The worker polls continuously; an empty poll sleeps for two seconds before trying again.
preconditions: SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are present when the worker starts.

outputs.name: claimed job
outputs.description: A generation_jobs row already marked running, or no row.

steps: Call claim_next_supported_generation_job with validate_cad as the only supported type.
Continue to Source Proof when a row is returned.
Sleep for two seconds when the RPC returns no row.

failureConditions.outcome: No durable state changes; the loop sleeps and polls again.
The exception is not caught inside the polling loop, so the process exits.

operations.concurrency: One job is processed at a time by each worker process.
operations.retry: Only empty polls repeat. The worker does not catch and retry claim RPC exceptions.
observability: Validation reports and unexpected processing exceptions are written to stdout/stderr.

nodes.label: 2. Source Proof
nodes.description: Restricts the source path, downloads source and parameters, and compares model.py with the job-bound SHA-256.

details.responsibility: Resolve the only permitted source object for the job and prove its bytes still match the queued source identity.
trigger: A claimed validate_cad job enters the validator.
preconditions: The row contains project_id, part_id, and source_sha256.

inputs.name: claimed job
inputs.description: Accepted or candidate source identity and ownership fields.

inputs.name: storage objects
inputs.description: model.py and the part params.json from 3dProjects.

outputs.name: hash-matched source
outputs.description: Decoded Python source, local model.py, params.json, and the actual SHA-256.

durableReads: 3dProjects accepted model.py or edit-scoped candidate model.py
steps: Resolve accepted model.py or validate the candidate path prefix and model.py suffix.
Create a job-local /tmp/validation_jobs/<job-id> workspace.
Download model.py and params.json.
Hash the downloaded model.py bytes and compare with source_sha256.
details.shortCircuit: A path violation raises before download. A hash mismatch returns cancelled with runtime skipped and no static validation.
details.successCondition: The downloaded model.py SHA-256 equals the source_sha256 stored on the active job.

failureConditions.condition: Candidate path is outside its edit-job prefix, traverses directories, or does not end in model.py
failureConditions.outcome: Processing raises and the worker records an unexpected failed result.
The job is cancelled as superseded; actual and expected hashes are retained and runtime is skipped.

guarantees: Candidate validation cannot select a model.py object outside the owning edit-job candidate prefix.

nodes.label: 3. Static Safety Gates
nodes.description: Runs ordered syntax, contract, decorator, reference, and forbidden-call checks before execution.

details.responsibility: Reject source that cannot satisfy the CAD module contract or that uses forbidden operations before project code executes.
trigger: Source Proof returns hash-matched Python source.

inputs.name: model.py source
inputs.description: UTF-8 Python source with its storage path.

outputs.name: static report
outputs.description: Schema-v2 checks, normalized diagnostics, stage, and safe_to_execute.

steps: Parse Python syntax.
Validate ModelParams, build_model, and required CAD-part decorators.
Validate decorator fields and literal values.
Validate parameter references.
Reject forbidden imports and calls.
decisionPoints: Each stage decides whether the prerequisites for later checks still hold.
details.shortCircuit: A failed stage marks dependent later checks skipped. Any static error keeps safe_to_execute false, so runtime execution does not occur.
details.successCondition: Every ordered check passes and safe_to_execute is true.

failureConditions.condition: Syntax, contract, decorator, reference, or security check fails
failureConditions.outcome: A failed schema-v2 report is returned and the isolated runtime is skipped.

guarantees: Project source reaches the runtime only when safe_to_execute is true.

nodes.label: 4. Isolated CadQuery Runtime
nodes.description: Runs statically approved source with isolated Python, a sanitized environment, timeout, and bounded output.

details.responsibility: Execute the approved CAD module and prove that build_model returns non-empty CadQuery solids.
trigger: Static Safety Gates sets safe_to_execute to true.
preconditions: model.py and params.json exist in the job-local source directory.

inputs.name: model.py
inputs.description: Hash-matched and statically approved project source.

inputs.name: params.json
inputs.description: A JSON object used to construct the module's ModelParams.

outputs.name: runtime result
outputs.description: Passed geometry facts or structured import, runtime, return-type, or empty-solid diagnostics.

steps: Start the validation runner with the current Python executable and -I.
Remove known Supabase/OpenAI credentials and *_TOKEN or *_SECRET variables.
Use job-local HOME and TMPDIR and disable user site packages.
Load params.json, import model.py, construct ModelParams, and call build_model.
Require a CadQuery Workplane or Shape with at least one solid.
details.successCondition: build_model returns a supported CadQuery value containing one or more solids.

failureConditions.condition: The subprocess exceeds the configured timeout
failureConditions.outcome: Runtime fails with VALIDATION_TIMEOUT and captured output remains bounded.

failureConditions.condition: Import, execution, return-type, or geometry validation fails
failureConditions.outcome: The runner writes structured diagnostics and no downstream export is scheduled.

guarantees: Captured stdout and stderr are each limited to the last 16,000 characters.
The subprocess environment removes configured service credentials and token/secret-suffixed variables.

operations.timeout: 60 seconds by default; CAD_VALIDATION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS must be a positive integer.
operations.concurrency: One runtime subprocess at a time per worker process.
operations.retry: The worker does not retry a failed runtime.
observability: Bounded stdout/stderr, exit code, timeout flag, stage diagnostics, result type, and solid count.

nodes.label: CAD Source Storage
nodes.description: The 3dProjects objects read for accepted or edit-scoped candidate validation.

details.responsibility: Durably own accepted CAD source, edit-scoped candidate source, and part parameters.
downstream: Source Proof is the reader in this service.

nodes.label: 5. Completion Gate
nodes.description: Persists the report and selects candidate completion, accepted completion plus export insertion, or failed/cancelled status.

details.responsibility: Translate the validation outcome and source mode into the correct durable generation_jobs transition.
trigger: validate_cad_job returns completed, failed, or cancelled, or processing raises unexpectedly.

inputs.name: validation outcome
inputs.description: Status, schema-v2 report, and concise error_message.

inputs.name: source mode
inputs.description: candidate or accepted from the claimed job.

outputs.name: candidate completion
outputs.description: The running candidate validation row becomes completed with its report.

outputs.name: accepted completion
outputs.description: The running accepted validation row becomes completed and a queued export_cad row is inserted.

outputs.name: non-passing completion
outputs.description: The row becomes failed or cancelled with report and error text.

durableWrites: queued export_cad generation_jobs row for passed accepted source only
steps: Print normalized diagnostics and the complete report.
For a completed candidate, call complete_candidate_cad_validation.
For a completed accepted source, call complete_cad_validation_and_queue_export.
For failed or cancelled validation, update the validation row directly.
For an unexpected processing exception, persist a schema-v2 worker-error report.
decisionPoints: Validation status first; source_kind distinguishes the two successful completion functions.
details.successCondition: The validation row records the report; accepted success also returns the inserted export job id.

failureConditions.outcome: Status failed, report, and concise error_message are persisted; no export row is inserted.
Status cancelled and the superseded report are persisted; no export row is inserted.
A failed worker-error report and bounded traceback text are persisted.

guarantees: Candidate completion never inserts an export job.
Accepted validation completion and export insertion occur in one database function and transaction after type, source-kind, running-state, and source-hash checks.

nodes.label: Export Jobs
nodes.description: Queued export_cad generation_jobs rows inserted only by successful accepted-source completion.

details.responsibility: Durably schedule CAD export after accepted source has passed validation.

inputs.name: export_cad row
inputs.description: Project, part, queued status, and the same source SHA-256 proven by validation.

durableWrites: One queued export_cad row for successful accepted-source validation.
downstream: CAD Exporter claims the queued row independently.
guarantees: This candidate-validation completion path does not write an export row.

response.label: claimed validation job or no row

details.summary: Job Claim asks Postgres to select the oldest queued validate_cad row with FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED and change it to running. The database returns that row or no row; it does not initiate work.
preconditions: The worker calls with validate_cad in p_job_types.
details.payload: A fixed supported-type list; there is no worker ID, lease, heartbeat, or reclaim field.
details.durability: A successful RPC persists status=running before returning the claimed row.
details.failureBehavior: No row causes a two-second sleep. An RPC exception escapes the polling loop.

details.summary: A returned validate_cad row enters Source Proof immediately in the same worker process.
preconditions: The claim RPC returned a row.
details.durability: Transient in-process handoff; the durable row already exists in Postgres.
details.failureBehavior: No row means this handoff does not occur.

details.summary: Source Proof initiates both object reads after resolving an accepted path or proving that a candidate path belongs to the active edit job.
preconditions: The source path is accepted or passes candidate-prefix, suffix, and traversal checks.
details.durability: Storage remains the durable owner; downloaded copies live only in the job-local temporary workspace.
details.failureBehavior: A download exception reaches the worker's unexpected-failure handler.

details.summary: Source Proof hands source to Static Safety Gates only after downloaded model.py matches the source hash bound to the active job.
details.payload: Decoded model.py source and its repository-independent storage path.
details.failureBehavior: A mismatch cancels the job as superseded and static validation does not run.

details.summary: Static Safety Gates starts isolated execution only when every required check permits it and safe_to_execute is true.
preconditions: Syntax, contract, decorator, reference, and forbidden-call checks produced no blocking error.
details.failureBehavior: A failed static stage skips runtime and returns a failed report to completion.
details.trustBoundary: Project-authored source crosses into a sanitized python -I subprocess.

details.summary: The runtime returns structured geometry facts or diagnostics to the worker, which folds them into the schema-v2 report before durable completion.
details.payload: Pass/fail status, stage, diagnostics, build_artifacts, bounded stdout/stderr, exit code, and timeout flag.
details.durability: Transient until Completion Gate persists the report.
details.failureBehavior: Runtime failure becomes a failed validation outcome; no export job is inserted.

details.summary: Completion Gate initiates the database operation that persists the schema-v2 report and terminal job status. The specific function depends on status and source mode.
details.payload: Job id, proven source SHA-256 for successful completion, result report, and error text for non-passing outcomes.
details.durability: The validation row retains its terminal status, report, and any concise error_message.
details.failureBehavior: A database exception propagates from process_job and is followed by mark_unexpected_failure; if that update also fails, the process does not repair the row.

details.summary: Successful accepted-source completion inserts a queued export_cad row using the same source SHA-256 and records that export job id on the validation result.
preconditions: Stored source_sha256 equals the proven request value.
details.payload: A new export_cad generation_jobs row for the same project, part, and source SHA-256.
details.durability: Export insertion and accepted validation completion occur in one Postgres function call and transaction.
details.failureBehavior: A failed precondition raises and the transaction does not commit the export insertion.

boundaries.label: CAD Validator Worker
boundaries.description: One polling Python process owns all five logical validation stages.

boundaries.label: Sanitized python -I subprocess
boundaries.description: Project source executes only within this job-local subprocess boundary.
